QuestInfo.name: Claudine's Information
QuestInfo.0: You meet Claudine in Edelstein to see if she has any insight into the Seal Stone theft.
QuestInfo.1: Claudine gives you a file on the Black Wing bosses. Deliver this file and Neinheart's document to the Dark Lord.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the information you received from Ereve and Edelstein to the Dark Lord.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 50,000
Can proceed to The Black Wings' Plot

0.0: That's right. The Resistance has its own sources of intelligence. \r\nI've prepared everything you seek in this file. Will you deliver it to the Dark Lord?

yes.0: This file contains all the information we have about the various Black Wing bosses, including the Master of Disguise.
yes.1: The Resistance owes much to the Dark Lord and Athena Pierce, and we pay our debts.

no.0: I see. Perhaps the Explorers are as unreliable as the Cygnus Knights...

1.0: You're back. I trust you've completed your mission?

yes.0: Nicely done. Give me a few moments to peruse these documents.

npc.0: Ugh, you went to the Cygnus Knights first. I assure you, #h0#, our files will be superior to that so-called tactician's... Please, deliver this file to the #bDark Lord#k.
